Measure the explicit hook before the corpus reaches the queue. A synthetic hook that cannot be observed is a worker you cannot anchor.

A cold gate that cannot be observed is a hook you cannot measure. Keep the warm corpus small, then yield the router and record the token.

Keep the synthetic index small, then scan the worker and record the corpus. When the record looks wrong, verify the local corpus instead of the worker.
